newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan proposes T$10 bln airport town - paper.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan proposes T$10 bln airport town - paper.

text.p: A Taiwan cabinet panel has proposed building a T$10 billion airport town in the nothern county of Taoyuan, the China Times Express evening newspaper said on Sunday.
The town would be completed in June 2000, the paper said. It will be built around the CKS international airport.
The northern part would comprise an air cargo zone, while the southern area would be for passenger airline-related service industries.
It would also have commercial, administration, entertainment and residential areas to house 36,000 people.
The proposal needs final approval by the full cabinet. The newspaper gave no further details.
